ucs.title: [LLM] Gamaredon (Shuckworm) USB worm — Explorer-spawned script host running from removable drive
ucs.description: Catches Gamaredon's signature USB propagation chain (Pterodo / LitterDrifter / GammaLoad family): a user double-clicks an LNK at the root of a removable drive that Windows resolves to cmd.exe /c start mshta.exe E:\<file>.hta (or wscript/cscript variants). Detects Explorer-parented script hosts whose command line references a non-system drive letter plus a script/LNK extension — a hallmark of Shuckworm's removable-media loader since at least 2022 (ESET WeLiveSecurity, Symantec Threat Hunter Team) and still observed by CERT-UA against Ukrainian government targets in 2024-2026.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name=explorer.exe AND Processes.process_name IN (mshta.exe,wscript.exe,cscript.exe,cmd.exe,powershell.exe) by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process Processes.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process,"(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\\\\S+\.(hta|vbs|vbe|js|jse|lnk|bat|cmd)\b") | where NOT match(user,"\$$") | eval drive=upper(substr(replace(process,".*?([D-Z]:\\\\).*","\1"),1,1)) | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "explorer.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\[^\\]+\.(hta|vbs|vbe|js|jse|lnk|bat|cmd)\b"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, SHA256, FolderPath
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\explorer.exe"
| where NewProcessName has_any ("\\mshta.exe","\\wscript.exe","\\cscript.exe","\\cmd.exe","\\powershell.exe")
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\[^\\]+\.(hta|vbs|vbe|js|jse|lnk|bat|cmd)\b"
| where Account !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Gamaredon (Shuckworm) USB worm - Explorer-spawned script host from removable drive
id: 7c4b0c6e-5b6a-4d2a-9e3d-1f0b6a2a7d11
status: experimental
description: Detects mshta/wscript/cscript/cmd/powershell launched by explorer.exe with a command line referencing a non-system drive letter (D:-Z:) and a script/LNK extension - the signature Gamaredon (Shuckworm / Aqua Blizzard / Primitive Bear) USB loader chain used to propagate Pterodo / LitterDrifter / GammaLoad.
references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2024/01/17/operation-texonto-information-operation-targeting-ukrainian-speakers-context-russias-invasion/
  - https://symantec-enterprise-blogs.security.com/threat-intelligence/shuckworm-ukraine-usb-malware
  - https://cert.gov.ua/article/6276894
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1091
  - attack.t1204.001
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1059.005
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
  selection_cmdline:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\[^\\]+\.(hta|vbs|vbe|js|jse|lnk|bat|cmd)\b'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate portable installer / autorun tooling staged on enterprise-issued USB media
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\EXPLORER.EXE OR *\\Explorer.exe) @Image:(*\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe) @CommandLine:(*D\:\\* OR *E\:\\* OR *F\:\\* OR *G\:\\* OR *H\:\\* OR *I\:\\* OR *J\:\\* OR *K\:\\*) @CommandLine:(*.hta OR *.HTA OR *.vbs OR *.VBS OR *.vbe OR *.lnk OR *.LNK OR *.js OR *.jse OR *.bat OR *.cmd)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^explorer\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(mshta|wscript|cscript|cmd|powershell)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)\\b[D-Z]:\\\\[^\\\\]+\\.(hta|vbs|vbe|js|jse|lnk|bat|cmd)\\b", field=CommandLine)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentImageFileName], function=([count(as=hits), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)]))
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Gamaredon is the only major Russia-attributed cluster that still leans heavily on USB-borne LNK->mshta/wscript propagation as a core access vector (Symantec, ESET, CERT-UA all confirm this through 2024-2026). The parent-must-be-explorer + child-must-be-script-host + cmdline-references-a-non-system-drive triple is extremely specific to user-clicked autorun-style LNKs at the root of removable media.

ucs.title: [LLM] Gamaredon GammaLoad dead-drop C2 resolution — script host beaconing to Telegram / Cloudflare workers / churning .ru TLDs
ucs.description: Catches GammaLoad / GammaSteel / Pterodo's signature dead-drop resolver behavior: the in-memory VBScript / PowerShell stager — typically launched seconds earlier by an Office document, mshta, or an Explorer-spawned LNK — fetches its real C2 address from t.me / api.telegram.org, a *.workers.dev or *.trycloudflare.com worker, or a churning free-DNS .ru / .ru-adjacent subdomain. Symantec, ESET and Palo Alto Unit42 (Trident Ursa) have repeatedly tied this resolver pattern to Gamaredon's persistent Ukraine-focused campaigns.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.app IN ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") by host All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.app All_Traffic.dest_domain All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_port | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | where dest_domain IN ("t.me","api.telegram.org","telegram.org") OR like(dest_domain,"%.workers.dev") OR like(dest_domain,"%.trycloudflare.com") OR like(dest_domain,"%.r2.dev") OR match(dest_domain,"(?i)\.(ru|fun|tk|cf|ga|ml|gq|info)$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowSeconds = 600;
let Resolvers = dynamic(["t.me","api.telegram.org","telegram.org","workers.dev","trycloudflare.com","r2.dev"]);
let ScriptSpawn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","explorer.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe")
    | where FileName in~ ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | project DeviceId, SpawnTime=Timestamp, ParentImage=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ScriptHost=FileName, ScriptCmd=ProcessCommandLine, AccountName;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where (isnotempty(RemoteUrl) and RemoteUrl has_any (Resolvers))
     or (isnotempty(RemoteUrl) and RemoteUrl matches regex @"(?i)\.(ru|fun|tk|cf|ga|ml|gq|info)(/|$)")
| join kind=inner ScriptSpawn on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, SpawnTime)
| project Timestamp, SpawnTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage, ParentCmd, ScriptHost, ScriptCmd,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMin = 10min;
let Resolvers = dynamic(["t.me","api.telegram.org","telegram.org","workers.dev","trycloudflare.com","r2.dev"]);
let ScriptSpawn = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("\\mshta.exe","\\wscript.exe","\\cscript.exe","\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe")
    | where ParentProcessName has_any ("\\winword.exe","\\excel.exe","\\powerpnt.exe","\\outlook.exe","\\explorer.exe","\\cmd.exe","\\mshta.exe")
    | project SpawnTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, ScriptHost=NewProcessName, ScriptCmd=CommandLine, ParentProcessName, Account;
DnsEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where Name has_any (Resolvers) or Name matches regex @"(?i)\.(ru|fun|tk|cf|ga|ml|gq|info)$"
| join kind=inner (ScriptSpawn) on Computer
| where TimeGenerated between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, SpawnTime)
| project TimeGenerated, SpawnTime, DelaySec, Computer, Account,
          ParentProcessName, ScriptHost, ScriptCmd, Name, QueryTypeName, ClientIP
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @Image:(*\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe) (@DestinationHostname:(*t.me OR *api.telegram.org OR telegram.org OR *.workers.dev OR *.trycloudflare.com OR *.r2.dev) OR @DestinationHostname:(*.ru OR *.fun OR *.tk OR *.cf OR *.ga OR *.ml OR *.gq))

| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)
